system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"Spotify starts up on Windows 10 even though it is disabled from settings and task manager. There seems to be no definite fix. <URL>"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! Can you let us know the exact Spotify version you’re using? This info will help us find a solution for you! Keep us posted! /AI"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply lacks troubleshooting steps and sounds informal; needs clearer guidance and tone adjustment."}
